users.deactivateBody: The user will no longer be able to sign in. Their data and activity history are kept; you can reactivate the account at any time.

users.privacyNote: Data minimisation: only what is needed to take part in the programme is stored — name, email, role, title and university. No ID numbers, phone numbers or addresses are collected. Deactivated accounts are not deleted so that the audit log stays complete.
